basic_info.description: Showcasing gorgeous curb appeal, a flexible 3-4bd/2ba and multi-floor entertaining layout, this 1,720 SF (per tax) solar-powered home is ideal for everyday modern living. The main level features a light-filled living/dining area overlooking Sutro Tower that flows seamlessly into the spacious kitchen with quartz countertops and stainless steel appliances - perfect for entertaining guests. Two bedrooms, a versatile den/office/bedroom, a full bath and multiple skylights throughout fills the home with natural light and functional space. Downstairs, find a full bedroom and bathroom - your potential primary suite, private office, or guest quarters - with direct access to a multi-level landscaped yard offering peek-a-boo views of rolling hills. Embrace cutting-edge living with solar panels, Tesla EV charger/powerwall, Z-wave light switches, and Ubiquiti access points for whole-home WiFi. A 1-car garage with interior access and built-in worktable completes the convenience of this home. Walkable to parks, schools and groceries. Short drive to San Bruno Ave., Bernal Heights, McLaren Park and Alemany Farmers Market. Easy 101 freeway and MUNI access.
